senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) hard, dry; old, of last year, opp. חָדָשׁ.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 91b:17">B. Bath. 91ᵇ</cite>, a. e. expl. <he>י׳ נוֹשָׁן</he> (<cite ref="Leviticus 26:10">Lev. XXVI, 10</cite>), v. <cite ref="J00698">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:20">Ab. IV, 20</cite> <he>קנקן חדש מלא י׳</he> a new vessel full of old wine (a young man but learned).
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:9">Ab. Zar. III, 9</cite> <he>ואם י׳ וכ׳</he> and if the oven is old (dried) &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְשָׁנִים</he>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 33a:7">Ib. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳ ומזופפין</he> old or pitched wine vessels.
Lev. R. s. 2, v. חָדָשׁ; a. fr.—Fem. יְשָׁנָה.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:5">Kidd. IV, 5</cite>, <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="A03140"><he>אַרְכִי</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <he>יְשָׁנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:10">Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:10">V</cite>), 10 <he>י׳ זפופות</he>, v. supra; a. fr.
